articles.summary: – Results Highlight the Potential of Long-Acting Regimens, Including Twice-Yearly and Once-Weekly Options, to Transform the Treatment and Prevention of HIV – Gilead Sciences, Inc. (Nasdaq: GILD) today announced its upcoming participation in the International Congress on Drug Therapy in HIV Infection ( HIV Glasgow 2026 ), taking place from November 8-11. As a leader in HIV innovation, Gilead will share new clinical data and real-world evidence from its HIV research and development programs and provide updates on its strategic initiatives and key collaborations. Results from more than 50 studies, including late-breaking data and two oral presentations, along with Gilead-led symposia and community forums, reflect the company’s person-centered approach to advancing scientific discovery and the importance of partnership to help end the HIV epidemic.
